topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: Well now, I reckon there’s a lesson in this for all of us. If folks were to take better care of their belongings, they wouldn’t find themselves in such a pickle. A man’s driveway ought to be as sacred as his hearth, and if something’s been taken from there, it means someone’s not been watchful enough. I’ve always said, a good lock and a sharp eye keep the wolves at bay. My tools and beasts are all accounted for, and that’s the way it ought to be. Neighbors should take a page out of the same book—tending to their own affairs and keeping their possessions safe. It’s a mark of a man’s worth, after all, how well he tends to what he has.
